correct_instructions_in_dataset: correct instructions in a dataset by creating a correction dictionary and applying it to all entries
calculate_edit_distance: calculate the Levenshtein edit distance between two strings using dynamic programming
find_closest_word_match: find the closest matching word from a list of targets within a given edit distance threshold
create_instruction_dictionary: create an InstructionDict from dataset entries with word and instruction frequency filtering
filter_words_by_frequency: filter a word frequency dictionary to keep only words appearing at least a minimum number of times
